# `index` command

Manage the package indexes searched by search, info and add (several side by side, none by default).

```bash
fobis index --help
```

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

### `fobis index add`

Add an index at the end of the user configuration's [indexes] (lowest priority).

Arguments: `NAME URL`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | TEXT |  | User configuration file (default ~/.config/fobis/config.ini). |
| `--check`, `--no-check` |  |  | Read and validate the index first. |

### `fobis index build`

Write an index from seeds, filling description, license and provides from each source.

Arguments: `SEEDS`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--output`, `-o` | TEXT | `index.toml` | Where to write the index. |
| `--name` | TEXT |  | Name of the index (default: the seeds' name). |
| `--from-ecosystem` |  |  | Seed from the projects of the user's ecosystem registry. |
| `--config` | TEXT |  | User configuration file (default ~/.config/fobis/config.ini). |
| `--force` |  |  | Overwrite an existing output file. |

### `fobis index check`

Validate an index: schema, names, and (with --online) that each source answers.

Arguments: `PATH`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--online` |  |  | Also check that every source is a readable source. |
| `--json` |  |  | Machine-readable output. |

### `fobis index list`

List the configured indexes in priority order, with their cache state.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | TEXT |  | User configuration file (default ~/.config/fobis/config.ini). |
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT | `fobos` | Project fobos whose [indexes] are searched first. |
| `--json` |  |  | Machine-readable output. |

### `fobis index remove`

Remove an index from the user configuration (and its cache).

Arguments: `NAME`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | TEXT |  | User configuration file (default ~/.config/fobis/config.ini). |

### `fobis index update`

Fetch the indexes again (and the indexes they follow).

Arguments: `NAME`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | TEXT |  | User configuration file (default ~/.config/fobis/config.ini). |
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT | `fobos` | Project fobos whose [indexes] are searched first. |
| `--depth` | INTEGER | `2` | How far 'follows' is walked (0: configured indexes only). |

<!-- cli:end -->
